objects.name: base
objects.prompt: A small, rustic woven wicker basket overflowing with freshly picked cavern mushroom caps. The basket is squat and rounded, made from warm brown interwoven reeds, with a sturdy curved handle. Inside are 8–12 plump mushroom caps of varying sizes, in muted violet, dusky blue, earthy brown and soft mauve, with occasional pale undersides and tiny turquoise bioluminescent speckles. A few caps spill slightly over the rim. Isolated inventory or storage object, transparent background, no scenery, no text.
